mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_operation (id, actor_type, actor_id, idempotency_key, route_id, fingerprint, status, visibility_status, course_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{routeId}, #{fingerprint}, #{status}, #{visibilityStatus}, #{courseId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, actor_type AS actorType, actor_id AS actorId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, route_id AS routeId, fingerprint, status, visibility_status AS visibilityStatus, course_id AS courseId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM upload_operation WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_operation SET status = #{status}, visibility_status = #{visibilityStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
